statement: Speaker diarization is a separate task from transcription.
actakit_implication: Model it as an optional derived representation/annotation capability, not an ASR requirement.

statement: Exclusive diarization is designed to simplify alignment with transcription timestamps.
actakit_implication: Useful if later civic video/audio requires speaker-attributed transcripts.

statement: Community pipeline can run offline after model acquisition.
actakit_implication: Diarization need not imply continuous cloud egress.
If integrated, ActaKit should default telemetry off and document model-fetch/network behavior.
